message.content:

| # | Schism | Approximate Dates | Key Parties Involved | Main Causes |
|---|--------|-------------------|----------------------|-------------|
| 1 | **Great Schism (East‑West Schism)** | 1054 – c. 1204 (formal split) | Eastern Orthodox Churches (Byzantine Empire) vs. Roman Catholic Church (Western Europe) | Doctrinal differences (Filioque clause, papal primacy), cultural and political tensions, and disputes over liturgical practices. |
| 2 | **Protestant Reformation** | 1517 – 1648 | Lutheran, Calvinist, Anglican, Anabaptist, and other emerging Protestant groups vs. Roman Catholic Church | Criticism of Catholic doctrines (e.g., indulgences, papal authority), calls for scripture‑centred theology, and the rise of national churches. |
|
